Roy Xing

Hello! I'm a PhD student in computer science at Dartmouth College, advised by Dr. Brian Plancher in the A²R Lab. I am grateful to have worked with Dr. John Baillieul and Dr. Jonathan Hurst in the past. I am interested in creating the equivalent of a motor cortex for robotic systems: how should high-level reasoning translate into physical movement for embodied intelligence? I love movement and the beautiful expressions that can emerge from motion. My ultimate goal is to create a kind robot, like BMO in Figure 1. Feel free to ask me more about what that means and entails! In my free time, I'm an art history dilettante who enjoys reading, building robots, and spending quality time with loved ones. Feel free to reach out if you'd like to chat!
